governs.description: Which PLANE this layer governs. assistant_workflow = the AI/CI workflow that BUILDS this repo (agents, their models, their tools). product_runtime = the shipped product's own behaviour. The two are separate: an assistant-plane model id sent to the product's provider fails every call and surfaces as a bad key, not a bad model. policy-ci asserts the separation.
